instruction: Extract all Python comments (lines starting with #) from code cells in the Karpathy GPT colab and save them to 'gpt_comments.txt' in the Home directory. Include one comment per line.

metadata.explanation: Task extracts Python comments from GPT Colab code cells. Evaluator verifies that extracted lines start with # and that there are at least 10 comments.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches the file from the specified path (/home/user/gpt_comments.txt)
Metric correctly verifies that lines start with '#' using proper format checking
Metric correctly handles the 'expected' parameter when type='rule' (directly accesses expected.get('min_comments') and expected.get('all_start_with_hash'))
Scoring breakdown is reasonable: 50% for minimum count, 50% for comment format validity
Minor issue: Using min_comments=10 only verifies at least 10 comments were extracted, not that ALL comments from the colab were extracted (partial verification)
Minor issue: No verification that comments actually came from the Karpathy GPT colab specifically (though this would be difficult to verify programmatically)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding metadata about expected comment count from the actual Karpathy GPT colab to better verify completeness
Could verify specific known comments from the colab to confirm source authenticity
